meta.name: security-review
meta.description: Security audit checklist for code changes. Run before committing to catch vulnerabilities.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在提交前检查代码变更中的安全漏洞
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在提交代码前需要快速检查常见安全问题
copy.tagline_en: Check code changes for security vulnerabilities before committing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick security checklist before pushing code

howto.what: Claude 会按照安全审查清单检查你的代码变更，覆盖输入验证、认证授权、密钥管理、依赖安全、错误处理、数据保护、注入防御和配置等方面，并给出严重等级（致命、高、中、低）及修复建议。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 审查代码变更的安全性，或在提交前运行安全检查时触发。

say.text: 帮我审查这段代码的安全性。
say.note: Claude 会运行完整的安全检查清单。

say.text: 检查这个函数有没有 SQL 注入风险。
say.note: Claude 会重点检查输入验证和注入防御。

say.text: 审查这个 PR 的代码变更，找出安全漏洞。
say.note: Claude 会针对变更部分进行安全审查。

howto.what_en: Claude runs a security review checklist on your code changes, covering input validation, auth, secrets, dependencies, error handling, data protection, injection prevention, and config, with severity levels (Critical, High, Medium, Low) and fix suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to review code security or run a security check before commit.

say_en.text: Review this code for security issues.
say_en.note: Claude runs the full security checklist.

say_en.text: Check this function for SQL injection.
say_en.note: Claude focuses on input validation and injection prevention.

say_en.text: Audit this PR's code changes for vulnerabilities.
say_en.note: Claude reviews only the changed parts.
